steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You know, you've been frowning ever since you came back from the restaurant.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If you're feeling worn out, then I'd be more than glad to––

options: What'd you think of the meal?
What do you think of Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It went well. You're getting pretty slick around these kinds of events, aren't you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I can tell. Even though the directors didn't show up in person, those corporate execs are all fond of you...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I said it already, but a certain spokesman took the fall and resigned over the Radiant Knight incident.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Malkiewicz was given that position in turn, but before that, he was a complete nobody, a minor player at best.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Though he still has a bit of that unvarnished human touch... I don't think it'll last very long in the environment he's in.

options: Do you think Rhodes Island's plan is feasible?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Let's set that aside for now... So, do you really trust me?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The infiltration of the General Chamber isn't some kind of conspiracy. In the face of money and a changing society, even if the K.G.C.C. did nothing, the knights would still fall to capital.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The courtesy that the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has extended to Rhodes Island is almost certainly linked to the Radiant Knight. That being the case, should a person as particular as you... inadvertently fail to return that courtesy, you'll be the one to suffer.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Brassrust Knight... is going to fight again?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes... Based on video evidence and the testimonies from other knights, the Knights Association proved to the National Council that what happened to that Infected was an exacerbation of his disease due to excessive casting.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Because the cause of death was 'Oripathy,' Brassrust Knight was not directly responsible, so...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Even if that was the case... then we should at least...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Leave me.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Put me through to the associate justice of the National Council... on a private line.

a.text: The busy tone rings out twice from the phone.
Malkiewicz suddenly flashes back to his childhood, to the copper-colored telephone that sat on the desk in his father's study.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Spokesman, have you come up with a solution?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: As long as Mr. Czarny no longer has the evidence, it's fine, right?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Of course... But as a friendly reminder, if this goes public late, we will both end up taking the blame.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Therefore, the safest option... is to get rid of him.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You have my assurances.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: My assurances... that I can keep Mr. Czarny muzzled.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: There's no need to concern yourself with my methods.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Very well then... As long as you can demonstrate your sincerity.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Tomorrow, I will begin the retrial of Olmer Ingra's case. If you can do that within seven days...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Olmer Ingra will thence disappear from the Major.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...I will.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Right. At the very least, you must prove to me that Mr. Czarny truly 'would never betray us.'

a.text: Malkiewicz remembers. He remembers that bronze-colored telephone.
Telephones were not as popular back then, and cables still coursed above bars, hostels, and roaring construction sites.
When it rang, it would bring joys and sorrows alike.
That was life in Kazimierz... Life in modernity.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: There's one thing I hope you understand...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You're provoking a spokesman.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You know as well as I do that I'm only a stand-in. I enjoy no support among the Board of Directors.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But that does not mean that I will abide your butchery.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The power to command the Armorless Union... was once in the hands of Mr. Czarny. And now...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Please don't mistake my intentions. I'm not trying to challenge your authority.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I'm simply reminding you.. to make sure our future cooperation goes smoothly.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: After all you've said, it wouldn't behoove me to run amok. That would be too discourteous after all.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: All I need is your assurance. Olmer Ingra is just another corrupt noble, and it hardly makes sense for someone like that to get in the way of our relationship, yes?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Then, there's nothing more for us to talk about.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Wait! Hold on, Mr. Malkiewicz, please––

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You smiled.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Woah! Mr. McKee, when did you...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I've never seen you smile like that before, my man.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Did you need something?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Naturally, the Armorless Union has already received their orders, and we still have a role to play in these matters. However...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Actually, never mind. Carry on with your work.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Alright, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Authority is the sweetest taste. Wouldn't you agree, Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Nothing beats strolling through these streets in the evening.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: As long as there's no work to be done, that is.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Reporting. Monique has led her team to the designated location.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: The target of this operation has been confirmed, and there are now about a hundred Infected hidden throughout the area.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ah. Score whatever kills you can. As I said before, the pay is determined by headcount.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Same old rules apply, no friendly fire.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: Hey, hey! We've got Armorless!

steps.name: An Infected Knight B
steps.text: Wh-What? You're kidding, right? This is the middle of Kawalerielki! They wouldn't dare start a bloodbath?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Not enough.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What? Wasn't Wild Mane supposed to distract the Armorless like you wanted?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But, it's not enough.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Did we overlook something...?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Prepare for the worst, Fartooth.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Don't underestimate the Armorless.

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: Run, run now!

steps.name: An Infected Knight B
steps.text: Calm down. What did you see?

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: B-B-Blue... A blue bow.

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: Huh?! You're kidding!

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: H-Hurry, tell the others, spread out and run! Hide in the garbage dumps if you have to!

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: Tell the Infected civilans to not resist. They can't resist, no matter what––

steps.name: An Infected Knight B
steps.text: N-Now, if there's anyone who can contact Pinus Sylvestris... Please hurry...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Haha... Ahahaha...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Reporting. We found three Infected.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hahaha... Haha...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Right, did I tell you about the offer I got from the Board of Directors?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: 300 gold for an illegal Infected. Twice that for an Infected knight.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Dammit! They found me!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Each Infected is worth a ticket to the Major. An Infected knight is worth half a good car.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: How should we deal with a special individual who isn't in that price schedule?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: How many forms of code signing have you been trained in?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Um, I think I remember how to use three.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hmm... Forget it. No need for any of that. If you see me... Mmm... Yes, snap my fingers.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If you see me snap my fingers, act immediately. No hesitation.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Alright. I'll head up to say hello.

a.text: Lazurite Roy walks forward, and the street lights flicker several times.
The blue-brick road stretches forward, not a single person on the street.
There is a bench on the side of the desolate road.
And upon the bench sits a desolate person.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Good evening. And a wonderful one at that, yes?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Did you happen to see the news? Tonight, it's nothing but the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: This place sure is empty. Haven't seen anyone else around. I hear it hasn't been too peaceful around these parts either.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What are you doing here all by yourself?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Roy... I just finished work. Just resting here for a spell.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: My, did you only get off work just now, this late? What a workaholic.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But... What kind of work would you be doing around here?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The only folks around these parts are the Infected, illegal immigrants, and black market traffickers, right?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Just waiting for someone.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What, are you even going to ask who I'm waiting for?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No, no, no, why would I?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Waiting for someone, huh? Let me guess... you had a date with a beautiful lady? Haha, just kidding...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But, we both have business here.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm afraid I have to ask you and your friend to step aside.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You mind your business, I mind my business.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Do you have any idea what you're saying, Młynar?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Was I speaking Gaulish?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, come on. If you're here, my underlings might slip up because they're so nervous.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, Młynar, did you know... if I wanted to kill you right now... how little effort it'd take?
Roy slowly lifts his hand.
In the dark, the Armorless Union assassins wait, poised to strike.
Though perhaps nothing than a faulty premonition, the masters of hiding in the shadows always feel most prone to being seen.
Młynar Nearl.
They begin to pray, praying that Roy would not give any signals––
A white-horned Sarkaz with a sword.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It really was... a beautiful lady, eh.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Am I late?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What are you looking at me for?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Do your job, Roy.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hm.
Roy's eyes meet with those of the Sarkaz for a moment.
There is only one thing on his mind.
How to strike up a conversation later, without embarrassing himself too much.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Haha, I suddenly had a change of heart. Turns out it'll rain later tonight, and I happened to forget my umbrella.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Should I take this as evidence that the Nearl family intends to shelter the Infected?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Take it however you'd like.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Margaret won again.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You ought to stop her.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Forgive me.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But if that is what she wills, then I will support her... I will be her pillar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You? You're a Sarkaz...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: As for the Infected situation, I'll assume you already contacted Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Your assistance is appreciated... The Armorless Union is a powerful enemy.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: If he insisted on slaughtering every Infected hiding in this area, I fear we would be powerless to stop him.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I just wanted to sit here.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Nothing more.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: If you want to know what Margaret has been through the last few years, I'm willing to tell you what I know.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Of course, if you'd prefer to ask her yourself...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I don't care.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I already understand, just from the look in her eyes.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Her mother and father, and even me in the past, all embraced that era of resplendence and glory.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You... are her true family.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You already know everything you need to know. From now on, I won't be lifting even a finger.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You can tell Margaret, and that... 'Rhodes Island.' Tell them beneath the glory-gilded exterior of the Grand Knight Territory... the extent of the rot on the inside.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But a more practical suggestion I have is to leave the Grand Knight Territory as soon as possible. Leave Kazimierz.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Try your best to leave this entire era behind. That's probably one of the few right choices anyone can make.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What a complicated person you are.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... stay away from me!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Damnit, are you with the Armorless? You––

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: No, you're not... You're... a Sarkaz?! Who are you?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I come in peace. The Armorless Union has already left.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Wh-What are you talking about...?

steps.name: An Infected Refugee
steps.text: Just now, just now, that Sarkaz blocked the Armorless...

steps.name: An Infected Refugee
steps.text: Just who are you? How do you have the guts to stand against them?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm a physician for the Infected.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: A Sarkaz... who claims to treat the Infected? What...

steps.name: An Infected Refugee
steps.text: It's so crazy I can almost believe it.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Fine then... So what do you want?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Kazimierz has the means to provide medical treatment to the Infected... That being the case, why do you still hide here, within the cracks of the city?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You're not from Kazimierz?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: No, this is something that even most people from Kazimierz wouldn't know... Wait, you said you're a physician for the Infected?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... You're from Area 0?!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm from a pharmaceutical company. This Area 0 that you mentioned... is that the place that shelters the Infected?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz has funded the establishment of a clinic hub specifically for the examination and treatment of Infected knights...
Shining is in no hurry to finish her sentence.
In the eyes of the Infected in front of her, she sees doubt, mistrust towards her, fear, and the slightest glimmer of hope.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You really aren't from Kazimierz... But that makes sense, they also hate the Sarkaz here. Ugh, sorry, but that's just how things are.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Do you treat the Infected over there?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Don't you think it's strange?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Such a big mobile platform has practically become a cage for the Infected knights. Did you know the Infected knights are examined and treated there, but they also 'live' there?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: As if existing like that can be called 'living' at all.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Alright, it seems you outsiders don't even know this much.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But if all the Infected were to live there...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Then there's not enough space, right?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Those Infected who can still make money will step back into the arena, or carry on... finding whatever odd jobs they can.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: For those who can't become knights, they'll be sent to off to do some iffy work... Mining, transporting, all in dangerous environments.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: And if you get hurt, and you can't even do that kind of manual labor...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Take a guess, outsider. Where do you think those Infected from Area 0 end up?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You may think it's a hospital, and the knights may think it's a prison. But let me tell you, it is neither.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The Infected are shipped there, washed of their dignity, stripped of their basic worth, and finally sent to the cutting boards to be culled.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: What you're looking at, Sarkaz, is a glorified slaughterhouse.
